items.title: Blue and Gold Hanukkah Place Setting
items.alt: A blue-rimmed plate, folded napkin and six-pointed paper star sit on a woven mat beside a silver fork and spoon.
items.description: Blue bands run through the oval woven place mat beneath a white plate with a deep blue rim. A folded pale-blue napkin and decorated star card occupy the center, with silver utensils along the sides.

items.title: Potatoes and a Grater for Latkes
items.alt: Potatoes, a box grater, grated potato and an onion sit on a wooden board with a checked cloth and Hanukkah candles.
items.description: A tall metal grater stands behind whole and peeled potatoes on the wooden preparation board. A patterned bowl holds the grated strands, while a checked cloth, onion and lit hanukkiah complete the arrangement.

items.title: Sharing Jelly Doughnuts Beside the Candles
items.alt: A boy in a blue kippah and a girl in a coral dress hold doughnut halves beside a small stool with Hanukkah candles and treats.
items.description: The two children hold split doughnuts with red filling visible in the soft centers. A small draped stool separates their teal and coral outfits and supports a candleholder and a plate of more doughnuts.

items.title: Learning the Dreidel Game
items.alt: An older man and a kneeling boy, both wearing kippot, watch a wooden dreidel and coins on a low table beside Hanukkah candles.
items.description: The older player leans forward from a wooden chair as his hand reaches over the dreidel’s handle. The boy watches from beside the low table, with gold gelt and a brass candleholder arranged between them.

items.title: Drawing a Star on a Hanukkah Card
items.alt: A child with glasses and a mustard cardigan draws a six-pointed star on a blue card at a desk beside colored pencils and candles.
items.description: A pale star shape forms on the blue folded card beneath the child’s pencil. Colored pencils and a plain envelope lie at the other end of the wooden desk, opposite the lit hanukkiah.

items.title: Bringing a Ribbon-Tied Treat Box
items.alt: A man in a blue kippah, coat and scarf offers a ribbon-tied box to an older woman at an open blue door.
items.description: Both people support the cream box between them at the doorway. The man’s blue coat and scarf echo the open door, while the older neighbor’s plum cardigan contrasts with its ribboned wreath.
